claude.result:
Perfect! I've successfully added weekly subscription support to subtrack. Here's what I implemented:

## Changes Made

**Core Logic** (`src/cycles.js`):
- Added `CYCLE.WEEK = 'weekly'` to support weekly billing cycles
- Updated `monthlyCents()` to calculate weekly costs as price × 52 ÷ 12, rounded to nearest cent (not cut off)
- Changed all monthly cost rounding from `Math.floor` to `Math.round` so yearly plans like €100.06 show €8.34/month (not €8.33)
- Updated `nextCharge()` to handle weekly plans charging every 7 days from their start date

**CLI** (`bin/subtrack.js`):
- Added "week"/"weekly" to the `--every` flag options
- Updated help text to show `--every month|year|week`
- Added weekly to the SHARE_PER_MONTH calculation for accurate totals

**Export** (`src/export.js`):
- Switched to using `monthlyCents()` function for consistent rounding across all output formats

**Renewals** (`src/renewals.js`):
- Fixed sorting to use actual dates instead of formatted strings for proper chronological order

**Documentation** (`README.md`):
- Added example: `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week --since 2026-10-02`
- Updated options to document weekly plans
- Explained weekly cost calculation in Money section

**Tests** (`test/cycles.test.js`, `test/cli.test.js`):
- Added tests for weekly plan cost calculation (€59.90/week = €259.57/month)
- Added tests for rounding to nearest cent
- Updated expectations for yearly plans to reflect proper rounding

## Verification ✓

- ✅ `npm test` passes all 37 tests
- ✅ `node bin/subtrack.js add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week --since 2026-10-02` works and shows €259.57/month
- ✅ Weekly and other cycle types work together in the same file
- ✅ Renewals lists weekly plans correctly (Meal kit on 30 Oct, every 7 days from 2 Oct)
- ✅ All commands (list, total, renewals, export) show weekly plans with their monthly cost
- ✅ Monthly costs rounded to nearest cent throughout
